stanza: Freedom from love
Freedom from the heartache

heartache.line: And I still chase you into heartache
stanza: I was never scared of nothing
I thought I had a home
Life went and broke me open
Cause I carried it alone
I'm finding all this well-worn sadness
I never knew I kept
And I still chase you into heartache
Every time you take a step

heartbreak.line: Say I'm an airplane and the gashes I got from my heartbreak
stanza: Say I'm an airplane and the gashes I got from my heartbreak
Make the slots and the flaps upon my wing, and I use them to give me a lift
Hip hip for the lift, hip hip for the drag, I want them all in my bag
Oh, give me anything, and I'll turn it into a gift

heartbreak.songTitle: It All Comes Out in the Wash
heartbreak.line: Every little stain, every little heartbreak
stanza: 'Cause it'll all come out, all come out in the wash
It'll all come out, all come out in the wash
Every little stain, every little heartbreak
No matter how messy it got
You take the sin and the men and you throw 'em all in
And you put that sucker on spin
American love
American me
American you
American tears
American heartbreak
Oh, oh, oh

heartbreak.line: I'm only one step ahead of heartbreak
stanza: I'm only one step ahead of heartbreak
One step ahead of misery
One step is all I'd have to take backwards
To be the same old fool for you I used to be
Yes boss, the government handshake
Yes boss, the crusher of language
Yes boss, Mr. Stillwater
The face at the edge of the banquet
The cool, the cool river
The cool, the cool river
What's your politics?
What's your religion?
What's your intake?
Your reason for living?
We're over a forest
There's millions of snowflakes
We're dancing

snowflake.songTitle: I Will Go Sailing No More
stanza: All the things I thought I'd be
All the brave things I'd done
Vanished like a snowflake
With the rising of the sun
Nevermore to sail my ship
Where no man has gone before
And I will go sailing no more
